title: eupatorium rugosum f. villicaule
intro: Eupatorium rugosum f. villicaule, commonly known as rough bedstraw, is a plant species in the Eupatorium genus. It is used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of rough bedstraw include reducing pain and inflammation, as well as exhibiting immunomodulatory and antiviral effects. The bioactive constituents of Eupatorium rugosum f. villicaule include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
